## ⚠️ Next: Install Node.js

Before running anything, you must install Node.js:

1. Download: https://nodejs.org/ (LTS version)
2. Install the .exe file
3. Restart PowerShell
4. Verify: `node --version`

**Then:** Follow QUICKSTART.md for next steps!

## 💡 One-Click Installation (After Node.js)

Double-click `install.bat` to install all dependencies automatically!

Or run manually:
```powershell
cd frontend && npm install
cd ../backend && npm install
```
